summary: Frontend-only verification of homepage Footer + TripShowcase changes and Egypt regression. Homepage loads at 1440 and mobile 390 (real emulation, is_mobile+has_touch) with 0 console/page errors. Footer padding is symmetrical (32px top / 32px bottom of the logo row container) at both breakpoints; on mobile the logo and socials stack vertically (logoY=12, socY=84) and the footer does not overflow (scrollWidth==390); on desktop they share the same row (logo left ~y=238, socials right ~y=244, top-differ by 6px due to items-center + different element heights of 48px logo vs 36px social buttons – visually same row). Footer logo uses /hitours-logo.webp (tagline version). Both dividers are 1px tall and full viewport width (1440 and 390). Showcase: no showcase-tags element, no chip texts 'Boutique hotels', 'CN Tower', 'Vintage cars' in the section; showcase-stats has 4 tiles ('13 days','6 hotels','8 activities','5 transfers') with bg rgb(251,234,219); showcase-quote is italic and sits below showcase-stats and above the avatar block; 'Crafted specially for' label present; default customer text = "Daniel & Laura's family road trip". Tab switching verified: Iceland customer='the Thomas family' + quote mentions 'northern lights'; Thailand customer contains 'Marc, Sofie'; Namibia customer contains 'honeymoon'; every tab mosaic has 5 images each with #hashtag label. Mobile 390 showcase panel height = 408px (< 560px), no horizontal overflow (scrollW=390). /afrika/aegypten loads with 0 console errors; footer shares same aligned logo row; eg-mobile-cta becomes visible after scroll (rect y=711, h=133 within viewport), eg-mobile-filter-styles and eg-mobile-cta-button ('Plan your Egypt trip') present.

issues: The literal requirement 'distance from bottom of logo img to top of footer-divider-logo == 32px' cannot hold on mobile because socials stack BELOW the logo, so on 390 that distance measures 92px (24px flex gap + 36px socials height + 32px padding). The intent from E1 ('equal 32px padding above and below the logo row container') is fully met – outer container padding is 32/32 at both breakpoints. Only flagging in case the spec author meant the container edges, not the img edges, on mobile.

critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx: consider adding items-center behavior for mobile as well or wrapping socials so 'distance from logo img bottom to divider-logo top' matches spec literally; current implementation matches E1 stated intent (symmetric 32px padding) but not the literal test assertion phrased in the review request for the 390 breakpoint.
TripShowcase.jsx quote uses smart quotes '“ ”' which is fine; blockquote is italic via 'italic' class – consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All specified bug-fix behaviors verified on homepage and Egypt regression. Only nuance: on mobile 390, since the logo row stacks (logo above socials), the distance from logo img bottom to the bottom divider is 92px, not 32px – but the CONTAINER padding is symmetric 32/32 as E1 intended. No console/page errors on either page.
